_comment_icons: The UI pack has no endurance, speed or recovery icon (plan §13), so related stat icons stand in for now.
_comment: Hand-authored bone upgrades (master plan Phase 7, client stats). Cost to buy level L is round(base * growth^(L-1)); effect_per_level is applied as described in 'effect'. All four stats speed up the same loop, so buying any of them shortens the climb to level 100.
